```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/update-mslearn-dates.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/update-mslearn-dates.yml'

jobs:
  validate-bicep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Bicep
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bicep
          
      - name: Validate Bicep files
        run: |
          find . -name "*.bicep" -exec bicep build {} \;
          
  build-and-package:
    needs: validate-bicep
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        
      - name: Build Toolkit
        run: |
          pwsh -File ./scripts/Build-Toolkit.ps1
          
      - name: Package Toolkit
        run: |
          pwsh -File ./scripts/Package-Toolkit.ps1
          
      - name: Verify metadata files
        run: |
          ls -la dist/**/*.bicep
          ls -la dist/package-manifest.json
          
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: toolkit-build
          path: dist/
          
  deploy-hub:
    needs: build-and-package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: toolkit-build
          path: dist/
          
      - name: Deploy hub
        uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          action: "upload"
          app_location: "/dist"
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN }}
          app_artifact_location: "/"
          
  test-dependencies:
    needs: deploy-hub
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        
      - name: Test dependency resolution
        run: |
          # Verify metadata contracts are properly defined
          $metadataFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Filter "metadata.bicep" -Recurse
          Write-Host "Found metadata files: $($metadataFiles.Count)"
          $metadataFiles | ForEach-Object { 
            Write-Host "Checking $_"
            # Basic validation that file exists and has content
            if ((Get-Content $_.FullName).Length -gt 0) {
              Write-Host "✓ Valid metadata file: $($_.Name)"
            } else {
              Write-Error "✗ Empty metadata file: $($_.Name)"
            }
          }
          
          # Verify package manifest includes metadata files
          if (Test-Path "dist/package-manifest.json") {
            $manifest = Get-Content "dist/package-manifest.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
            Write-Host "Manifest contains $($manifest.files.Count) files"
            $hasMetadata = $manifest.files | Where-Object { $_ -like "*metadata.bicep" }
            if ($hasMetadata) {
              Write-Host "✓ Metadata files found in manifest"
            } else {
              Write-Error "✗ No metadata files found in manifest"
            }
          } else {
            Write-Error "✗ Package manifest not found"
          }
```
